title: First voyage around the world
place: Seville and Sanlúcar de Barrameda, Spain (start and finish)
summary: A Spanish fleet led by Magellan sailed west around South America and across the Pacific. Magellan was killed in the Philippines; Elcano brought one ship home.
why: Proved ships could sail around the world westward and revealed the vast size of the Pacific.

notes.problem: Source infobox gives Sanlúcar as start and end port (fleet left Seville downriver); 'how huge the Earth is' not in source: it says the voyage revealed the Pacific's vast scale.
